findings.title: Gaza records 260 birth defect cases in first nine months of 2026
findings.affected_population_system: Newborns and maternal/neonatal healthcare; 260 congenital anomaly cases reported January–September 2026 vs. 184 over all of 2022 and 322 during 2025
findings.exact_supporting_passage: 260 cases of congenital anomalies were recorded among newborns during the first nine months of 2026
findings.source_type: Gaza Health Ministry figures reported by WAFA, with attributed ministry statement and name of director-general in Anadolu

bounded_discovery_context.publication_time_basis: WAFA English 16:14 and Arabic 15:57 local Palestine time, both after previous hourly completion
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: WAFA and Anadolu report the same underlying Health Ministry claim, not independent case audits. Different period lengths and absent live-birth denominators prevent direct prevalence comparisons; no causal attribution established. Treat as a newly published medical assessment, not a change that occurred within this hour.
